paths.description: Homepage/trending grid and sound-button primary interaction; representative listing plus first-visit consent state.
Memes category; representative category/listing template. Other categories were excluded as duplicate templates.
VINE BOOM SOUND detail; representative sound-detail and playback/share journey.
Search results for “boom”; representative discovery flow from query to result.
Upload entry redirects to sign-in; representative authentication/form boundary. Authenticated upload/account actions were not covered because no credentials were provided.
Unknown route; representative HTTP 404 and recovery state.

findings.summary: A first-visit consent wall obscures the entire core experience.
findings.evidence: Desktop and 360 px screenshots show the consent dialog covering the soundboard before any interaction; the mobile dialog fills almost the whole viewport.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a less obstructive, accessible consent presentation with essential content still available and choices immediately clear.

findings.summary: Many controls are too small and several focused controls lose a visible focus indicator.
findings.evidence: The focus/target probe found 61 of the first 80 focusable controls below 44×44 px; favorite/copy buttons measure 25×25 px, and the search input/button styles report outline: none.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase interactive targets to at least 44×44 CSS px (or equivalent spacing) and provide a strong :focus-visible ring on every control.

findings.summary: Largest Contentful Paint is far outside the good range.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 14.3 s, TBT 280 ms, and performance 0.64; the independent trace measured LCP 3.47 s and TBT 372 ms.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the actual LCP content, shorten redirects/document latency, and defer ad/analytics work until after the primary content is visible.

findings.summary: The page ships a large amount of unused JavaScript and CSS.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 785 KiB unused JavaScript and 43 KiB unused CSS; major ad libraries were 50–85% unused on this view.
findings.suggestedFix: Load ad and analytics modules conditionally, remove duplicate Google tag loads, and replace the broad Bootstrap bundle with page-level CSS.

findings.summary: Listing templates lack headings/main landmark and focus treatment is inconsistent.
findings.evidence: After consent dismissal, the accessibility probe found zero headings and zero <main> landmarks; focused search/install controls computed outline: none while links relied on browser auto outlines.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a single descriptive h1, a <main> landmark, and consistent :focus-visible styles in DOM reading order.

findings.summary: Mobile reflow works, but target sizing does not.
findings.evidence: The 360 px layout had no horizontal overflow, but 61 sampled controls were below 44×44 px, including repeated 25×25 px action buttons.
findings.suggestedFix: Preserve the responsive grid while enlarging or spacing all repeated action targets for touch and zoomed use.

findings.summary: HTTPS is used, but core security headers and cookie flags are missing.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive found no CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame protection, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy; five first-party cookies lacked Secure and all six used SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy; mark HTTPS cookies Secure and choose Lax/Strict unless None is required.

findings.summary: A large tracking and advertising footprint loads on first visit.
findings.evidence: The tracker scan saw 12 third-party origins including Google Tag Manager, DoubleClick and Google Analytics; HAR shows scripts account for 1.34 MB of 1.52 MB transferred.
findings.suggestedFix: Block non-essential third parties until consent, consolidate analytics, and remove vendors that do not provide proportionate user value.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defensive policies are absent.
findings.evidence: Response inspection found no HSTS, clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, or CSP frame-ancestors.
findings.suggestedFix: Add HSTS and a tested CSP including frame-ancestors, plus strict referrer and least-privilege permissions policies.

findings.summary: Advertising and tracking work dominates a simple soundboard page.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 20 scripts and 1.34 MB script transfer; Lighthouse identified 785 KiB unused JS and the trace recorded a 421 ms long task.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer vendor work until needed/consented, eliminate duplicate analytics, and stop background ad work when the page is hidden.

findings.summary: Third-party cost is disproportionate to the visible first-view experience.
findings.evidence: Twelve third-party origins load on a page whose core UI is a server-rendered button grid; third-party/ad scripts dominate transferred bytes and unused code.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party byte/request budget, load vendors after consent and interaction, and retain only integrations with measured value.

findings.summary: Reduced-motion preference does not suppress all non-essential motion.
findings.evidence: The evaluate probe under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce reported one running animation with a 1000 ms duration.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap non-essential animations and transitions in a no-preference query and disable them under reduce.

findings.summary: The consent overlay is injected as custom div chrome rather than a native dialog.
findings.evidence: DOM probing found a visible role=dialog implemented as nested divs and no open <dialog>; dismissal is managed by third-party script.
findings.suggestedFix: Configure or replace the CMP UI so modal semantics, focus containment, Escape behavior, and dismissal use native dialog behavior where possible.

findings.summary: Third-party scripting blocks the main thread.
findings.evidence: The trace recorded two long tasks, the longest 421 ms, with 372 ms total blocking time; Lighthouse reported 2.3 s of main-thread work.
findings.suggestedFix: Delay non-essential ad-tech, split long tasks, and schedule remaining work by priority after the sound grid is interactive.

findings.summary: Redirects, cache policy, and render-blocking dependencies delay content.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported 780 ms redirect savings, 210 KiB cache-lifetime savings, 560 ms document-latency savings, and render-blocking requests; HAR captured 57 requests and 1.52 MB transferred.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the locale redirect for known routes, set useful cache headers, self-host/trim critical styles, and defer non-critical scripts.

findings.summary: Consent-dialog text fails minimum contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured the “Learn more” text at 1.82:1 against its effective background, below the required 4.5:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Raise foreground/background contrast in the CMP theme to WCAG AA and retest all consent states.

findings.summary: Deprecated APIs and DevTools issues are present.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found three deprecation warnings (Shared Storage, persistent StorageType, Protected Audience) and cookie-related Inspector issues from the third-party stack.
findings.suggestedFix: Update or remove dependencies invoking deprecated APIs and resolve the third-party cookie issues before browser removals land.

findings.summary: Authentication is password-only and omits modern credential support.
findings.evidence: The upload journey redirects to a login form with text/password fields, no passkey/WebAuthn affordance, and empty autocomplete attributes; no permission prompt fired on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey sign-in and set username/current-password autocomplete tokens as a fallback.

findings.summary: The multilingual site does not declare document direction.
findings.evidence: The page offers 11 languages and html lang=en, but html dir is empty; CSS probing found some logical properties, so the remaining gap is explicit direction and RTL verification.
findings.suggestedFix: Set dir from the active locale, use logical properties consistently, and test an RTL translation.

findings.summary: The consent wall pressures a decision before access to the soundboard.
findings.evidence: First-visit screenshots show the entire page dimmed behind a mandatory consent decision and a long vendor/data explanation on mobile; core content cannot be used until choosing.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow immediate essential use, keep accept/reject equally prominent, and move granular vendor settings behind a concise, neutral disclosure.

findings.summary: Sign-in fields omit autocomplete tokens.
findings.evidence: The login probe found empty autocomplete attributes on both login and password inputs.
findings.suggestedFix: Use autocomplete="username" and autocomplete="current-password" and keep labels associated.

findings.summary: Repeated image assets lack dimensions and are often oversized for display.
findings.evidence: The images primitive found 97/100 images without width/height, 64 oversized, and 50 below-fold images without lazy loading; formats were modern SVG.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare dimensions, use correctly sized icons, and lazy-load genuinely below-fold imagery while preserving eager loading for visible controls.

findings.summary: The initial memory footprint is high for the page’s core function.
findings.evidence: The baseline heap summary contained 627,670 nodes, 2,399,182 edges, and 34.9 MB self size for a server-rendered sound-button listing; repeated playback did not increase it.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce third-party script/object populations and avoid constructing offscreen controls until near the viewport.

findings.summary: Page-to-page changes are abrupt rather than using progressive View Transitions.
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS feature probing across the MPA found no view-transition declaration or ::view-transition usage on category, search, or detail navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Add @view-transition { navigation: auto } and stable view-transition-name values for shared page chrome, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Long listing pages provide no scroll-position feedback.
findings.evidence: The 3,540 px mobile homepage uses static navigation; source/CSS probing found no scroll-state query, progress indicator, or scroll-linked navigation feedback.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight declarative scroll progress or scroll-state-aware header for long listings.

findings.summary: The page logs a network error during load.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse captured net::ERR_CONNECTION_CLOSED while loading /media/manifest.json.
findings.suggestedFix: Make manifest delivery reliable and ensure failed optional requests are handled without console errors.

findings.summary: Rich sound entities lack structured data.
findings.evidence: The sound detail exposes useful Open Graph audio metadata, but probes found no JSON-LD describing the AudioObject and its visible title, description, and URL.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate schema.org AudioObject JSON-LD to sound-detail pages while retaining the existing Open Graph tags.
